tei:div.tei:p: ༁ྃ: zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las/ bskang bshags nyams chag rang grol gyi thugs dam bskang ba'i rim pa bzhugs so//

kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi bskang bshags nyams chag rang grol nyams su len par 'dod pas/ gnas yid dang mthun par phyag dar rkyang nul byas la stegs bu nag 'jam mkhregs pa'i steng du zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor bri/ dbang bskur bar 'dod na bum pa lnga dang dbang rdzas rnams sta gon bya/ cho ga la'ang rnam rgyal bum pa dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhag go /dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' bskor du bhan+dha brgya dang rtsa brgyad/ rak+ta brgya dang rtsa brgyad/ gtor ma brgya dang rtsa brgyad/ lha bshos brgyad dang rtsa brgyad/ thabs shes tshogs rdzas sha zan brgya dang rtsa brgyad/ snang gsal mar me brgya dang rtsa brgyad kyis bskor/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa la gtor ma bzang du bshams/ de'i phyi rol du phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa rgyas par bshams/ bla ma yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyi sku rten yod na'ang bkram/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon 'dus pa rgya mtsho dang bcas pa bde ba'i stan la 'khod nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang sngon 'gro gser skyems nas bzung ste las byang tshor ba rang grol ltar bstod pa yan chad rgyas par bya/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon 'dus pa rgya mtsho rnams la sngon gyi bram ze dung gi phreng ba can gyi lo rgyus dang*/ na raka dong sprugs kyi lo rgyus bshad/ dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ 'gyod tshangs bshags pa'i rim pa dang thugs dam bskang ba'i rim/ dbang bskur gnas spar gyi rim pa'o// dang po 'gyod tshangs bshags pa'i rim pa la'ang bzhi ste/ lus kyi sgo nas mos gus phyag gi bshags pa dang gcig /ngag gi sgo nas byin rlabs sngags kyi bshags pa dang gnyis/ yid kyi sgo nas rtog tshogs lta ba'i bshags pa dang gsum/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas smre bshags 'gyod tshig gi bshags pa dang bzhi'o// dang po lus kyi sgo nas mos gus phyag gi bshags pa ni/

brgya phyag sdig sgrib rang grol ltar 'tshal lo// ngag gi sgo nas byin rlabs sngags kyi bshags pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' spyi bor bsgom zhing yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzla zhing ye shes sku mchog kyang bya'o// yid kyi sgo nas rtog tshogs lta ba'i bshags pa ni/ lta ba'i klong bshags ltar bya'o// lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas smre sngags 'gyod tshig gi bshags pa ni/ rū tra'i smre sngags dang klong bshags brjod pa rang grol gyi nang nas gang yod brjod par bya/ yang na dri med bshags rgyud las gsungs pa'i smre bshags chen mo ltar bya'o// de dag ni 'gyod tshangs bshags pa'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa thugs dam bskang ba'i rim pa la bzhi ste/ phyi thun mong mchod pa'i rdzas kyis bskang ba dang*/ nang thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzas kyis bskang ba dang*/ gsang ba khyad par bla med tshogs kyis bskang ba dang*/ de kho na nyid don dam byang chub sems kyis bskang ba'o// skabs 'dir tshogs kyi yo byad thams cad bshams la bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la bzhag /dang po phyi thun mong mchod pa'i rdzas kyis bskang ba ni/ yon chab/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams mched lcam rnams kyis bzung nas dkyil 'khor bskor zhing*/ yid kyis kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin ltar dmigs shing dbyangs snyan pos 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag na// lha rdzas mchog gi yon chab dang*// lha rdzas mchog gi zhabs bsil 'di// rgyu rkyen rnam par dag pa'i rdzas// bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'dis// bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang*// dam can rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ hūm̐/ stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag na// lha rdzas mchog gi me tog dang*// lha rdzas mchog gi bdug spos 'di// rgyu rkyen rnam par dag pa'i rdzas// bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'dis// bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang*// dam can rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/

hūm̐/ stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag na// lha rdzas mchog gi snang gsal dang*// lha rdzas mchog gi dri chab 'di// rgyu rkyen rnam par dag pa'i rdzas// bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'dis// bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang*// dam can rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ hūm̐/ stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag na// lha rdzas mchog gi zhal zas dang*// lha rdzas mchog gi rol mo 'di// rgyu rkyen rnam par dag pa'i rdzas// bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'dis// bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang*// dam can rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol// nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol// zhes phyi mchod kyis thugs dam bskang ngo*// gnyis pa nang thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzas kyis bskang ba la'ang bzhi ste/ dang po bdud rtsi sman gyis bskang ba ni/ mched lcam rnams kyis lag pa g.yas su bdud rtsi bzung*/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gis bdud rtsi 'thor zhing dkyil 'khor bskor la 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ kun gzhi klong yangs bhan+dha ru// byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis bkang*// bskang ba'i rdzas mchog bla na med// chos kyi sku yi thugs dam bskang*// bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol// blo mdangs gsal ba'i bhan+dha ru// ye shes sgrib med bdud rtsis bkang*// bskang ba'i rdzas mchog bla na med// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i thugs dam bskang*// bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol// mchog gi 'od gsal bhan+dha ru// thig le 'bar ba'i bdud rtsis bkang*// bskang ba'i rdzas mchog= sprul pa'i sku yi=

bskang gyur dbang dang= ye shes rtsa yi bhan+dha ru// skye med a dkar bdud rtsis bkang*// bskang ba'i rdzas mchog= zhi ba'i lha tshogs= bskang gyur dbang dang= ye shes lnga yi bhan+dha ru// shes rab rang gsal bdud rtsis bkang*// bskang ba'i rdzas mchog= khro bo'i lha tshogs= bskang gyur dbang dang= stong gsum snod kyi bhan+dha ru// rang rtsal bcud kyi bdud rtsis bkang*// bskang ba'i rdzas mchog= bkram pa'i lha tshogs= bskang gyur dbang dang= mtshan ldan ka la'i bhan+dha ru// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsis bkang*// bskang ba'i rdzas mchog= zhi khro rab 'byams= bskang gyur dbang dang = nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ zhes bdud rtsis thugs dam bskang ngo*// gnyis pa rak+tas thugs dam bskang ba ni/ mched lcam rnams kyis lag pa g.yon pas rak+ta bzung zhing*/ g.yas pas rak+ta 'phyar zhing dkyil 'khor bskor la 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru// sdug bsngal rnam par grol ba'i rak+tas bkang*// gnyis med bde ba chen po'i chags pas bskyed// 'di yang rmad byung bskang ba'i rak+ta ste// bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang*// bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru// sna tshogs yid las grol ba'i rak+tas bkang*// gnyis med bde ba chen po'i chags pas bskyed// 'di yang rmad byung bskang ba'i rak+ta ste// bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang*// bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru// bsam gtan blo las grol ba'i rak+tas bkang*// gnyis med bde ba chen po'i chags pas bskyed// 'di yang rmad byung bskang ba'i rak+ta ste// bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams=

bskang gyur dbang dang= lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru// nyon mongs rtsa mdud grol ba'i rak+tas bkang*// gnyis med bde ba chen pos= 'di yang rmad byung bskang ba'i= bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams= bskang gyur dbang dang= gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru// ye shes bde chen thig le'i rak+tas bkang*// gnyis med bde ba= 'di yang rmad byung= bcom ldan zhi khro= bskang gyur dbang dang= mtshan ldan mi mgo lcang lo'i bhan+dha ru// su ra dmar chen rdzas sbyar rak+tas bkang*// gnyis med bde ba chen pos= 'di yang rmad byung = bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams= bskang gyur dbang dang = nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /bskang gyur dbang dngos grub stsol// zhes rak+tas thugs dam bskang ngo*// gsum pa gtor mas thugs dam bskang ba ni/ rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir bzung la 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ bhan+dha 'bar ba'i gtor gzhong du// shangs kyi rlung sgrom dpal bshos btsugs// 'khor lo 'bar ba'i mtheb kyus bsgron// sgron ma mig gi dza gad gsal// dbang po lnga yi rak+tas bran// bskang ba'i gtor ma bla na med// zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang*// bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol// nyi zla ga'u'i gtor gzhong du// tsit+ta 'bar ba'i dpal bshos btsugs// pad+ma 'dab brgyad mtheb kyus bsgron// rnam shes tshogs brgyad dza gad gsal// rtsa chen bzhi yi rak+tas bran// bskang ba'i gtor ma= zhi khro rab 'byams= bskang gyur dbang dang= brdal khyab lpags pa'i gtong gzhong du// rus pa rang gsal dpal bshos btsugs// rang snang sha yi mtheb kyus bsgron// bkrag dang gzi mdangs dza gad gsal// khrag dang chu ser rak+tas bran// bskang ba'i gtor ma=

zhi khro rab 'byams= bskang gyur dbang dang= khog pa stong pa'i gtor gzhong du// mchin pa rang gsal dpal bshos btsugs// glo mtsher mkhal ma'i mtheb kyus bsgron// ghu h+ya nang rol dza gad gsal// rang snang mkhris pa'i rak+tas bran// bskang ba'i gtor ma= zhi khro rab 'byams= bskang gyur dbang dang= rin chen snod kyi gtor gzhong du// gtsang sbyar 'bru zan dpal bshos btsugs// sna tshogs zan gyi mtheb kyus bsgron// 'bru bcud bdud rtsis dza gad gsal// gu h+ya mu la'i rak+tas bran// bskang ba'i gtor ma= zhi khro rab 'byams= bskang gyur dbang dang = nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol// zhes gtor mas thugs dam bskang ngo*// bzhi pa snang gsal mar mes thugs dam bskang ba ni/ mched lcam rnams kyis mar me re re thogs la dkyil 'khor bskor zhing 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ brdal khyab lpags pa'i kong bu ru// khrag dang chu ser mar khus gtams// sha dang rus pa'i sdong bu btsugs// rang gsal bkrag mdangs sgron me sbar// 'di yang rang byung zhun mar te// bskang ba'i zhun chen bla na med// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol// bhan+dha 'bar ba'i kong bu ru// go ro tsa na'i mar khus gtams// gsal byed rtsa yi sdong bu btsugs// dbang po lnga yi sgron me sbar// 'di yang rang byung zhun mar te// bskang ba'i zhun chen bla na med// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol// tsit+ta 'bar ba'i kong bu ru// snying tshil dkar dmar mar khus gtams// pad+ma 'dab brgyad sdong bu btsugs// rnam shes tshogs brgyad sgron me sbar// 'di yang rang byung zhun mar te// bskang ba'i zhun chen=

dkyil 'khor lha tshogs= bskang gyur dbang dang= dwangs ma lnga yi kong bu ru// sgrib med 'od lnga'i mar khus gtams// don snying lnga yi sdong bu btsugs// 'gyu byed dbugs kyi sgron me sbar// 'di yang rang byung= bskang ba'i zhun chen= dkyil 'khor lha tshogs= bskang gyur dbang dang= a wa dhu ti'i kong bu ru// rang gsal 'od kyi mar khus gtams// 'khor lo bdun brtsegs sdong bu la// byang chub sems kyi sgron me sbar// 'di yang rang byung= bskang ba'i zhun chen= dkyil 'khor lha tshogs= bskang gyur dbang dang= mi shigs thig le'i kong bu ru// skye med ye shes mar khus gtams// rtsa phran bcu yi sdong bu btsugs// rig pa rang byung sgron me sbar// 'di yang rang byung= bskang ba'i zhun chen= dkyil 'khor lha tshogs= bskang gyur dbang dang= ye shes rtsa yi kong bu ru// a dkar rtsa gcig mar khus gtams// ye shes 'od zer sdong bu btsugs// shes rab 'bras bu'i sgron me sbar// 'di yang rang byung= bskang ba'i zhun chen= dkyil 'khor lha tshogs= bskang gyur dbang dang= mchog gi 'od gsal kong bu ru// gdangs gsal 'od kyi mar khus gtams// thig le 'bar ba'i sdong bu btsugs// ye shes lnga yi sgron me sbar// 'di yang rang byung= bskang ba'i zhun chen= dkyil 'khor lha tshogs= bskang gyur dbang dang= kun gzhi klong yangs kong bu ru// chos kyi dbyings kyi mar khus gtams// byang chub sems kyi sdong bu btsugs// sku lnga lhun grub sgron me sbar// 'di yang rang byung= bskang ba'i zhun chen= dkyil 'khor lha tshogs= bskang gyur dbang dang= rin chen sna lnga'i kong bu ru// rtsi mar 'bru mar mar khus gtams// ras dkar dri med sdong bu btsugs// 'byung ba me yi sgron me sbar// 'di yang rdzas kyi= bskang ba'i zhun chen= dkyil 'khor lha tshogs= bskang gyur dbang dang = nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig

/las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol// zhes snang gsal mar mes thugs dam bskang ngo*// de nas mched lcam rnams kyi lag tu mar me re re thogs la dkyil 'khor tha ma bskor zhing mgrin gcig tu dbyangs kyis 'di skad smon lam gdab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// rdo rje slob dpon gnyan gyis dbu bzung nas// rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob mched dang lcam dral rnams// nam zhig byang chub lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe// 'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen por mi ltung zhing*// ma rig mun pa'i nang du mi 'thum la// gcong rong zab mo'i nang du mi skye bar// dmyal ba'i zangs khar lam du mi ltung zhing*// gcan gzan gdug pa'i sgra skad mi grags te// las kyi mtshon rnon dbal gyis mi phog shog /bshes gnyen dam pa bka' drin che ba dang*// dam tshig gcig pa'i rdo rje'i mched grogs rnams// shes rab gnyen gyis 'brel ba'i gzungs ma gsum// tshe rabs 'di dang tshe rgyud thams cad du// mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis// sa bcu rim gyis khyad par bsgrod par shog /nam zhig tshe 'phos lus brjes dus byung tshe// ma rig gti mug rmongs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis// 'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen por lhung srid na// gsal ba'i sgron me thugs rje der ma chung*// snang ba'i go 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'di// rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon zhig /zhe sdang mnar ba'i las kyi sdug bsngal gyis// dmyal ba'i zangs khar lam du lhung srid pas// gsal ba'i sgron me thugs rje der ma chung*// snang ba'i go 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'di// rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon zhig /nga rgyal khro gtum khengs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis// gcan gzan gdug pa'i sgra skad thos srid pas// gsal ba'i sgron me thugs rje der ma chung*// snang ba'i go 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'di// rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon zhig

/'dod chags 'dzin pa'i las kyi sdug bsngal gyis// gcong rong zab mo'i nang du skye srid pas// gsal ba'i sgron me thugs rje der ma chung*// snang ba'i go 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'di// rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon zhig /phrag dog zug rngu'i las kyi sdug bsngal gyis// mtshon cha gdug pa'i dbal gyis phog srid pas// gsal ba'i mar me thugs rje der ma chung*// snang ba'i go 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'di// rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon zhig /sa bcu'i khyad par rim gyis bsgrod pa'i tshe// nyon mongs bag chags ma lus der byang nas// 'gro don thogs pa med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// sa bcu gcig char rdzogs par gyur nas ni// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mdun bsus shig /byang chub sems ma rnams kyi mtha' skyor zhig /khro bo khro mo rnams kyis rgyab brten zhig /sa bcu'i khyad par rtse mor phyin pa'i tshe// phyir mi ldog pa'i dngos grub der thob bo// kun tu 'od kyi sa la phyin pa'i tshe// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis shul mtshon zhig /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mtha' skyor zhig /ye shes ting nge 'dzin gyis rgyab brten zhig /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la phyin pa'i tshe// gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis shul mtshon zhig /mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mtha' skyongs shig /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rgyab brten zhig /pad+ma can gyi sa la phyin pa'i tshe// shes rab ting nge 'dzin gyis shul mtshon zhig /sgo ba chen po rnams kyis mtha' skyongs shig /ta krita chen po rnams kyis rgyab brten zhig /'khor lo tshogs chen sa la phyin pa'i tshe// 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis mdun bsus shig /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis rgyab brten zhig /ma tshogs dbang phyug rnams kyis mtha' skyongs shig /bkod pa rab rdzogs sa la phyin pa'i tshe// ye shes khro bo rnams kyi zhal mthong nas// rig 'dzin rnams kyi zhing du skyes nas kyang*// bla med sku gsung thugs su 'grub par shog

/shes bya'i sgrib pa ma lus der byang nas// yi ge gsum gyi gol sa der bkag go /de wa ko sha'i sa la phyin pa'i tshe// che mchog he ru ka yis mdun bsus shig /kro ti shwa ri yum gyis mtha' skyongs shig /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis srog brten zhig /thar pa chen po'i grong du phyin pa'i tshe// gzi brjid 'od dpag med kyis mdun bsus shig /gnyis med shes rab yum gyis mtha' skyongs shig /yi dam lha yis rgyab nas srog skyobs shig /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ming 'dzin sar phyin tshe// gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis shul mtshon zhig /mnyam pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis mtha' skyongs shig /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis rgyab brten zhig /lcang lo can gyi sa la phyin pa'i tshe// dbyer med ting nge 'dzin gyis shul mtshon zhig /grub pa'i 'bras bu mchog gi mtha' skyongs shig /rdzogs pa bla med sa la phyin pa'i tshe// khyab brdal ting nge 'dzin gyis shul mtshon zhig /'ub chud ting nge 'dzin gyis mtha' bsdus shig /srid gsum ngang rdzogs sa la phyin pa'i tshe// thig le chen po'i ngang du lhun grub nas// 'od zer 'phrul bzhad chen por mtha' bsdus shig /bya rtsol gnyis med sa la phyin pa'i tshe// chos sku skye ba med pa'i don rtogs nas// sna tshogs longs sku thabs mkhas thugs rje yis// ma 'gags sprul pas 'gro don byed par shog /ces pa la sogs pa'i smon lam dang*/ gzhan yang theg pa chen po'i smon lam gang shes gdab par bya'o//

gsum pa gsang ba khyad par bla med tshogs kyis bskang ba ni/ tshogs rdzas rnams mched lcam rnams kyis btegs la/ tshogs kyi spyan 'dren dang tshogs phud 'bul ba rnams las byang ltar byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐// zhes 'dzab dbyangs sgrogs la tshogs bshags bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ dbus nas badz+ra satwa hūm̐// rdo rje rigs kyi thugs dam las// zhe sdang dam tshig nyams so 'tshal// 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags// shar nas bai ro tsā na oṃ// de bzhin rigs kyi thugs dam las// gti mug dam tshig nyams so 'tshal// 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags// lho nas rat+na saṃ bha traṃ// rin chen rigs kyi thugs dam las// nga rgyal dam tshig nyams so 'tshal// 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags// nub nas pad+ma dha ra hrī// pad+ma rigs kyi thugs dam las// 'dod chags dam tshig nyams so 'tshal// 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags// byang nas a mo sid+dhi āḥ las kyi rigs kyi thugs dam las// phrag dog dam tshig nyams so 'tshal// 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags// oṃ gha na tsakra satwa sa ma ya// zhes sogs tshogs kyi yig brgya bzlas shing tshogs phud gtor mar 'bul/ bsgral ba dang mchod pa la sogs las byang ltar bya/ de nas zhi khro'i mdangs bskang ni/ mched lcam rnams kyis bdud rtsi sbreng*/ rak+ta 'phyar/ rol mo dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing*/ dang po zhi ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang ba 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ rnam shes phung po gnas dag pa'i// rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs dam bskang*// gzugs kyi phung po gnas dag pa'i// rnam par snang mdzad thugs dam bskang*// tshor ba'i phung po gnas dag pa'i// rin chen 'byung ldan= 'du shes phung po gnas dag pa'i// snang ba mtha' yas= 'du byed phung po gnas dag pa'i// don yod grub pa'i= nam mkha'i ngo bo gnas dag pa'i// kun tu bzang mo'i=

sa yi ngo bo gnas dag pa'i// sangs rgyas spyan ma'i= chu yi ngo bo gnas dag pa'i// mā ma ki yi= me yi ngo bo gnas dag pa'i// na bza' dkar mo'i= rlung gi ngo bo gnas dag pa'i// dam tshig sgrol ma'i= rigs lnga yab yum gtso bo bcu// bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang*// nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol// khams dang skye mched gnas dag pa'i// sems dpa' sems ma'i thugs dam bskang*// mig gi rnam shes gnas dag pa'i// sa yi snying po'i= rna ba'i rnam shes gnas dag pa'i// nam mkha'i snying po'i= sna yi rnam shes gnas dag pa'i// spyan ras gzigs kyi= lce yi rnam shes gnas dag pa'i// phyag na rdo rje'i= mig gi dbang po gnas dag pa'i// byams pa mgon po'i= rna ba'i dbang po gnas dag pa'i// sgrib pa rnam sel= sna yi dbang po gnas dag pa'i// kun tu bzang po'i= lce yi dbang po gnas dag pa'i// 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i= nye ba'i sras mchog sems dpa' brgyad// bskang ngo mchod do= nyams chag thams cad= rtog sgrib thams cad= las ngan sdig sgrib= khams gsum 'khor ba= 'bras bu sku gsum= bskang gyur dbang dang= gzugs su snang ba gnas dag pa'i// rdo rje sgeg mo'i= sgra ru grags pa gnas dag pa'i// phreng ba ma yi= dri ru mnam pa gnas dag pa'i// glu dbyangs ma yi= ro bro'i ngo bo gnas dag pa'i// rdo rje gar ma'i= 'das dus rtog pa gnas dag pa'i// puṣ+pe ma yi= ma 'ongs rtog pa gnas dag pa'i// dhu pe ma yi= da lta'i rtog pa gnas dag pa'i// ā lo ke yi= 'byung ba ma nges lha mo ni// ghan+dhe ma yi= dgyes pa skong mdzad sems ma brgyad// bskang ngo mchod do= nyams chag thams cad= rtog sgrib thams cad= las ngan sdig sgrib=

khams gsum 'khor ba= 'bras bu sku gsum= bskang gyur dbang dang= lus kyi rnam shes gnas dag pa'i// gshin rje gshed po'i= lus kyi dbang po gnas dag pa'i// stobs po che yi= lus kyi reg yul gnas dag pa'i// rta mgrin rgyal po'i= lus kyi reg shes gnas dag pa'i// bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i= rtag par lta ba gnas dag pa'i// lcags kyu ma yi= chad par lta ba gnas dag pa'i// zhags pa ma yi= bdag tu lta ba gnas dag pa'i// lcags sgrog ma yi= mtshan mar lta ba gnas dag pa'i// dril bu ma yi= sprul pa'i sgo ba yab yum brgyad// bskang ngo mchod do= nyams chag thams cad= rtog sgrib thams cad= las ngan sdig sgrib= khams gsum 'khor ba= 'bras bu sku gsum= bskang gyur dbang dang= nyon mongs nga rgyal gnas dag pa'i// lha yi thub pa'i= nyon mongs phrag dog gnas dag pa'i// lha min thub pa'i= nyon mongs 'dod chags gnas dag pa'i// mi yi thub pa'i= nyon mongs gti mug gnas dag pa'i// byol song thub pa'i= nyon mongs ser sna gnas dag pa'i// yi dwags thub pa'i= nyon mongs zhe sdang gnas dag pa'i// dmyal ba'i thub pa'i= rigs drug dong sprugs thub pa drug /bskang ngo mchod do= nyams chag thams cad= rtog sgrib thams cad= las ngan sdig sgrib= khams gsum 'khor ba= 'bras bu sku gsum= bskang gyur dbang dang= yid kyi rnam shes gnas dag pa'i// rgyal ba kun bzang= chos khams sna tshogs gnas dag pa'i// kun tu bzang mo'i= zhi ba sangs rgyas bzhi bcu gnyis// bskang ngo mchod do= nyams chag thams cad= rtog sgrib thams cad= las ngan sdig sgrib= khams gsum 'khor ba= 'bras bu sku gsum= bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol// de nas khro bo'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang ba ni/ hūm̐/ rang rig nyon mongs gnas gyur pa'i// che mchog he ru ka yi= ma rig nyon mongs gnas gyur pa'i// yum chen kro ti'i= khrag 'thung gtso bo yab yum gnyis// bskang ngo mchod do=

nyams chag thams cad= rtog sgrib thams cad= las ngan sdig sgrib= khams gsum 'khor ba= 'bras bu sku gsum= bskang gyur dbang dang= rnam shes zhe sdang gnas gyur pa'i// badz+ra he ru ka yi= gzugs phung gti mug gnas gyur pa'i// bud+dha he ru ka yi= tshor ba nga rgyal gnas gyur pa'i// rat+na he ru ka yi= 'du shes 'dod chags gnas gyur pa'i// pad+ma he ru ka yi= 'du byed phrag dog gnas gyur pa'i// karma he ru ka yi= phyin ci log rtog gnas gyur pa'i// rak+sha he ru ka yi= myong byed rtog pa gnas gyur pa'i// sa nu he ru ka yi= skye gnas rtog pa gnas gyur pa'i// ghu h+ya he ru ka yi= reg bya'i rtog pa gnas gyur pa'i// yak+sha he ru ka yi= khrag 'thung gtso bo he ru dgu// bskang ngo mchod do= nyams chag thams cad= rtog sgrib thams cad= las ngan sdig sgrib= khams gsum 'khor ba= 'bras bu sku gsum= bskang gyur dbang dang= hūm̐/ nam mkha' bkrag mdangs gnas gyur pa'i// badz+ra kro ti'i= sa khams sha chen gnas gyur pa'i// bud+dha kro ti'i= chu khams khrag chen gnas gyur pa'i// rat+na kro ti'i= me khams drod chen gnas gyur pa'i// pad+ma kro ti'i= rlung khams dbugs chen gnas gyur pa'i// karma kro ti'i= drod skyes rtog pa gnas gyur pa'i// rak+sha kro ti'i= mngal skyes rtog pa gnas gyur pa'i// sa nu kro ti'i= brdzus skyes rtog pa gnas gyur pa'i// ghu h+ya kro ti'i= sgong skyes rtog pa gnas gyur pa'i// yak+sha kro ti'i= yum chen kro ti shwa ri dgu// bskang ngo mchod do= nyams chag thams cad= rtog sgrib thams cad= las ngan sdig sgrib= khams gsum 'khor ba= 'bras bu sku gsum= bskang gyur dbang dang= ha/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i// kau'u rī ma yi= yid kyi rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i// tsau'u rī ma yi= nyon mongs rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i// pra mo ha yi= lus kyi rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i// be ta li yi=

mig gi rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i// puska si yi= rna ba'i rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i// ghasma ri yi= sna yi rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i// sme sha ni yi= lce yi rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i// tsan+ḍa li yi= gnas kyi kau'u rī ma mo brgyad// bskang ngo mchod do= nyams chag thams cad= rtog sgrib thams cad= las ngan sdig sgrib= khams gsum 'khor ba= 'bras bu sku gsum= bskang gyur dbang dang= he/ don dam sems su gnas gyur pa'i// sengha ma yi= chos kyi khams chen gnas gyur pa'i// byā kri ma yi= bag chags 'thug po gnas gyur pa'i// sri la ma yi= reg bya'i ngo bo gnas gyur pa'i// shwa na ma yi= gzugs kyi ngo bo gnas gyur pa'i// kri ta ma yi= sgra grags ngo bo gnas gyur pa'i// kaṅka ma yi= dri mnam ngo bo gnas gyur pa'i// kha khwa ma yi= ro bro'i ngo bo gnas gyur pa'i// hu lu ma yi= yul gyi sengha phra men brgyad// bskang ngo mchod do= nyams chag thams cad= rtog sgrib thams cad= las ngan sdig sgrib= khams gsum 'khor ba= 'bras bu sku gsum= bskang gyur dbang dang= dzaḥ rtag par 'dzin pa gnas gyur pa'i// lcags kyu ma yi= chad par 'dzin pa gnas gyur pa'i// zhags pa ma yi= bdag tu 'dzin pa gnas gyur pa'i// lcags sgrog ma yi= mtshan mar 'dzin pa gnas gyur pa'i// dril bu ma yi= rta gdong ye shes sgo ma bzhi// bskang ngo mchod do= nyams chag thams cad= rtog sgrib thams cad= las ngan sdig sgrib= khams gsum 'khor ba= 'bras bu sku gsum= bskang gyur dbang dang= hūm̐/ stong khams gnas nas spor ba'i phyir// nyi zer zhags 'phen ma yi= mi rnams gnas nas spor ba'i phyir// mdung thung 'phen ma'i= stong khams gnas nas spor ba'i phyir// dril 'khrol ma yi= lha rnams gnas nas spor ba'i phyir// khyung thogs ma yi= lha min gnas nas spor ba'i phyir// skar mda' 'phen ma'i= yi dwags gnas nas spor ba'i phyir// glog phreng 'dzin ma'i=

byol song gnas nas spor ba'i phyir// glag sha rdeb ma'i= dmyal ba'i gnas nas spor ba'i phyir// ral gri 'dzin ma'i= rigs drug spor byed chen mo brgyad// bskang ngo mchod do= nyams chag thams cad= rtog sgrib thams cad= las ngan sdig sgrib= khams gsum 'khor ba= 'bras bu sku gsum= bskang gyur dbang dang= bh+yo/ sgal tshigs nyer brgyad gnas gyur pa'i// dbang phyug nyer brgyad= zhi ba'i las rnams mdzad pa'i phyir// dkar mo ma bdun= rgyas pa'i las rnams mdzad pa'i phyir// ser mo ma bdun= dbang gi las rnams mdzad pa'i phyir// dmar mo ma bdun= drag po'i las rnams mdzad pa'i phyir// ljang mo ma bdun= dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong mdzad ma// dbang mo nyer brgyad= khrag 'thung lha tshogs bdun cu drug /bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni// mchog chen mchog phran mtshan dang ldan// za le 'bri dang shel sgong lug /tsa ra mkha' lding mdangs kyis bskang*// bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa dang*// rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ dang*// rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang*// rnal 'byor tshogs kyi longs spyod dang*// sha chen lang ling sna tshogs dang*// snang gsal zhun gyi mar me dang*// sha chen gsur gyi dud pa dang*// thod pa ltag sprod rnga sgra dang*// rkang chen dung gi gling bu dang*// thun mong mchod pa sna tshogs kyis// zhi khro'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// khyed kyi thugs dam bskang gyur nas// bdag gi g.yar dam sor stsol cig /g.yar dam skong la rkyen ngan zlog /de nas rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang ba ni/ hūm̐/ snang srid phur bus gdab pa'i phyir// rdo rje gzhon nu'i thugs dam bskang*// yab yum gnyis su med pa'i phyir// 'khor lo rgyas 'debs= gnyis med thugs las sprul pa'i phyir// phur pa sras kyi= phyogs bcur sprul pa 'gyed pa'i phyir// khro bo pha bcu'i=

yab kyi dgyes pa skong ba'i phyir// khro mo ma bcu'i= thugs kyi sprul pa 'gyed pa'i phyir// za byed pha bcu'i= yum gyi thugs las sprul pa'i phyir// gsod byed ma bcu'i= chos kyi dbyings las sprul pa'i phyir// shwa na mabazhi'i= sha khrag kun la dbang byed pa'i// bse mo bzhi yi= gling bzhi kun la dbang byed phyir// bdag nyid ma bzhi'i= dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir// skyes bu ging bzhi'i= khrag gi rgya mtsho skem pa'i phyir// ma bdun sring bzh-i'i= rū dra rnam gsum bsgral ba'i phyir// ging chen bco brgyad= thugs kyi sprul pa bkye ba'i phyir// 'bar ma dgu yi= phyogs bcur pho nya 'gyed pa'i phyir// pho nya drug cu'i= rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams// bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang*// nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol// zhes pa dang*/ gzhan yang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi bskang ba mang du bya'o// de nas rdo rje slob dpon 'dus pa rgya mtsho dang bcas pas tshogs la rol/ nyams skyong rdo rje'i glu gar la sogs pa 'gags med kyi spyod pa bskyangs/ tshogs lhag kyang bsdus la gtso bo'i zhal chab bran/ lhag ma bsngos te btang ba'am/ yang na lhag ma ma btang ba'i gong du/ bzhi pa de kho na nyid don dam byang chub sems kyi bskang ba ni/ rnal 'byor pho mo mched lcam rnams rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ dpa' brtul gyi nyams bskyed/ dbang po hur bton/ phyag rgya gar dang stangs stabs bsgyur zhing*/ hūm̐/ dngos po chos nyid yangs pa'i klong du bskang*// snang ba ye shes chen po'i klong du bskang*// gsal ba shes rab 'bar ba'i klong du bskang*// sdug bsngal ka dag chos nyid klong du bskang*// kun rdzob don dam gnyis med klong du bskang*// khams dang skye mched gnas dag pa'i// zhi ba'i lha tshogs klong du bskang*// nyon mongs rtog tshogs gnas gyur pa'i// khro bo'i lha tshogs klong du bskang*// mchod du med de gnyis med rol pas mchod// bskang du med de skye med ngang du bskang*// sbyor du med de zung 'jug chen por sbyor// bsgral du med de mnyam nyid dbyings su bsgral// ye sbyor ye sgrol chen pos thugs dam bskang*// zhes pas bskang*/

a la la ho/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ho/ dgongs su gsol lo/ rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dbyings na bzhugs shing dus gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang nas byon pa'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro/ rang rtsal rig pa'i klong nas rang byon pa'i bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ bstan srung pho nya las mkhan dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dgongs su gsol/ 'di ltar bdag cag rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral 'dus pa rgya mtsho rnams kyis bla med yang dag mchog gi mchod pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba la brten nas bdag sogs sems can thams cad khams gsum du 'khor zhing rigs drug gi duḥkha la spyod pa rnams kyi dam tshig nyams chag 'gal 'khrul nyes ltung thams cad kun bzang yangs pa chen po'i klong du kha bskang zhing bde chen chos nyid kyi dbyings su sor chud par gyur cig /ma hā sid+dhi sa ma ya/ e ma ho/ a a āḥ /ces pas bskang bar bya zhing lhag ma bskyal lo// de dag ni thugs dam bskang ba'i rim pa'o// gsum pa dbang bskur ba rnams ni 'og tu shes par bya'o// rjes kyi bya ba rnams la bskul ba dang*/ dpang gzu/ sgo dbye/ zor brdeg /brtan skyong*/ gtor bro/ dngos grub blangs ba/ bzod gsol/ bkra shis/ bsngo ba/ smon lam/ gshegs gsol/ rdzogs rim la sogs pa rnams ni las byang ltar rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun la bya'o// bskang bshags nyams chag rang grol gyi thugs dam bskang ba'i rim pa 'di nyid o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis zhi khro'i mdangs bskang mdzad pa la brten nas rang 'dra blo dman rnams kyi don du 'grig chags su bkod pa 'di ni khyi lo hor zla bzhi pa'i yar tshes la rgya ra ba nam mkha' chos kyi rgyal mtshos dpal chos mkhar rtse ru bris pas dge bas sems can thams cad 'khor ba ngan song gi sdug bsngal las grol bar gyur cig
